question: What is the full form of ‘BPO’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Business Process Outsourcing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The full form of BPO is **Business Process Outsourcing**.
 
• BPO involves contracting of specific business tasks, such as customer service or accounting, to a third-party service provider.
 
• It allows companies to focus on their core business functions and improve efficiency.
 
• BPO services can be categorized into back-office outsourcing, including internal business functions such as human resources or finance, and front-office outsourcing, which includes customer-related services such as contact center services.
 
• BPO can help businesses reduce costs, improve service quality, and access global talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IT Outsourcing**

 
 
• Involves subcontracting IT functions to external vendors, including software development, infrastructure management, and technical support.
 
• Helps businesses access specialized skills and technologies while reducing costs.
 
 
 
• **Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)**
 
 
• Focuses on outsourcing knowledge-intensive tasks such as research, data analysis, and financial consultancy.
 
• Requires advanced analytical and technical skills to perform high-level processes.
 
 
 
• **Human Resource Outsourcing (HRO)**
 
 
• Involves contracting out human resources functions like recruitment, payroll, and employee training.
 
• Allows organizations to streamline their HR processes and focus on strategic HR activities.
